# Cropper.js (vendored)

- **Package:** [cropperjs](https://github.com/fengyuanchen/cropperjs) v1.6.2
- **Files:** `cropper.min.css`, `cropper.min.js`
- **Used by:** profile photo upload (`static/js/profile-photo-crop.js`) on `/portal/profile/` and `/accounts/profile/`.
